# 1. Open data

```{r}
select <- dplyr::select
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(DHARMa)
library(glmmTMB)
library(car)
library(performance)

overdisp_fun <- function(model) {
  rdf <- df.residual(model)
  rp <- residuals(model, type = "pearson")
  Pearson.chisq <- sum(rp^2)
  prat <- Pearson.chisq / rdf
  pval <- pchisq(Pearson.chisq, df = rdf, lower.tail = FALSE)
  c(chisq = Pearson.chisq, ratio = prat, rdf = rdf, p = pval)
}

crop <- read.csv(file="5.temporal_plant_family/input/region_and_crop_type.csv",sep=";")%>% 
  mutate(id_parcelle=as.factor(id_parcelle)) %>% 
  rename(crop=TypeCulture)

plants_tot <- read.csv(file="5.temporal_plant_family/input/dataset_plant_families.csv") %>% 
  select(-X) %>% 
  mutate(id_parcelle=as.factor(id_parcelle)) %>% 
  left_join(crop) 



plots_plus_sept <- plants_tot %>% 
  select(id_parcelle,year) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(id_parcelle) %>% 
  mutate(nbre_annee= n_distinct(year)) %>% 
  select(id_parcelle,nbre_annee) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  filter(nbre_annee > 7)

plants_year <- plants_tot %>% 
  filter(id_parcelle %in% plots_plus_sept$id_parcelle)
#write.csv(plants_year,file="5.temporal_plant_family/output/plants_year.csv")
```

# 2. Dynamic of abundance of each family

```{r}
plants_year$year <- plants_year$year - mean(plants_year$year)
```


## 2.1. Poaceae

```{r}


mod_nb1 <- glmmTMB(
  Poaceae ~ year + (1 | id_parcelle),
  data = plants_year,
  family = nbinom1
)
mod_nb2 <- glmmTMB(
  Poaceae ~ year + (1 | id_parcelle),
  data = plants_year,
  family = nbinom2
)

AIC(mod_nb1,mod_nb2)

res_nb1 <- simulateResiduals(mod_nb1, n = 1000)
testDispersion(res_nb1)
testZeroInflation(res_nb1)
plot(res_nb1)

res_nb2 <- simulateResiduals(mod_nb2, n = 1000)
testDispersion(res_nb2)
testZeroInflation(res_nb2)
plot(res_nb2)

sum(plants_year$Poaceae == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
mean(plants_year$Poaceae == 0, na.rm = TRUE)

summary(plants_year$Poaceae)

mean(predict(mod_nb1, type = "response"))

sim <- simulateResiduals(mod_nb1, n = 1000)

sum(plants_year$Poaceae == 0)

mean(
  apply(sim$simulatedResponse, 2, function(x) sum(x == 0))
)


predict(mod,plants_year[plants_year$Poaceae==0,],type="response")

```


```{r}
mod <- glmmTMB(Poaceae ~ year + (1| id_parcelle) ,  data=plants_year,family=nbinom1)


sim_res <- simulateResiduals(mod, n = 1000)
plot(sim_res)
testDispersion(sim_res)
testZeroInflation(sim_res) # too much zero

mod2 <- glmmTMB(Poaceae ~ year + (1| id_parcelle) , data=plants_year,family=nbinom1, ziformula = ~1)

sim_res_zi <- simulateResiduals(mod2)
testZeroInflation(sim_res_zi)
AIC(mod,mod2) # zero inflated model better
overdisp_fun(mod2)

summary(mod2)
summary(mod)
Anova(mod2)
r2(mod2)
r2(mod)
```

0.008 \*\*\*

# 3. Per crop type

```{r}
plants_year_ann <- plants_year %>% 
  filter(crop!="Vineyard")
plants_year_vin <- plants_year %>% 
  filter(crop=="Vineyard")
```

## 3.1. Annual crops

mod <- glmmTMB(Poaceae ~ year + (1| id_parcelle) , data=plants_year_ann,family=nbinom1)
